closure_mapping.position_identity: Coherent journal account scope + environment + full canonical instrument + market form one stable account_position_id. Original booked trades.id is retained separately as the episode reference; candidates/cycles/confidence cannot regenerate it. Distinct account/instrument/environment scopes remain distinct. The existing account scope is the resolved journal path; relocation is not registered account-migration authority.
closure_mapping.agreeing_strategies: Existing Portfolio selects one same-instrument expression with bounded size, not summed candidate exposure. Every exact strategy/version remains inspectable. Existing holdings bind their original approved entry plan, not an incoming candidate version. No additional comparator, weighting or vote-count authority.
closure_mapping.opposing_strategies: Opposing version identities, directions, candidate evidence, lineage and proposal refusal reasons persist. Existing Portfolio conflict/CASH/KEEP policy remains authoritative; no consensus is fabricated and no opposite position is created.
closure_mapping.lineage_independence: Exact duplicates contribute once. Existing common-factor root groups retain parent/child and siblings; full ancestor Research/QNT records remain visible, including shared upstream evidence across roots. Distinct registered roots/strategies remain distinct evidence. independent_evidence_count is null and confidence_aggregation is NONE.
closure_mapping.position_stability: Confidence/evidence_quality changes do not change the held side/quantity, original booked identity or approved entry-plan receipt. Existing Portfolio admits no new size for SUPPORTS_EXISTING and TradeIntent KEEP has no requested size. The evidence module has no journal/position write API. Stops, targets, trails, partial and scale-in geometry cannot be rewritten by it; detailed execution authority remains EXE-04.
closure_mapping.exit_plan_binding: Frozen entry identity re-verifies exact StrategyVersion, strategy/spec hash, historical install, validation, exit semantics and exact entry exit_state. Existing pure exit initialize/decode checks the frozen policy against that exact version; wrong identity/geometry refuses. No geometry redesign. Legacy/adopted positions stay UNKNOWN.
closure_mapping.cash_risk_unreconciled: Only independent venue truth supplies position rows. CASH, invalid/rejected candidates, missing economics and Risk refusal never create holdings. Unreconciled observed holdings stay visible with REFUSED_UNRECONCILED attribution and no fabricated booked id/plan. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.
closure_mapping.replay: Reorder and a new-process replay preserve exact representation; immutable evaluations retain earlier supporting/opposing truth while later cuts append. Missing current validated lineage or corrupt/mismatched supplied lineage refuses. Historical v1 checkpoint receipts replay unchanged; v2 mandates the position receipt and verifies exact recomputation.
closure_mapping.authority: Observation-only binding; no execution/Risk/Portfolio expansion/Governor/owner/venue/exit mutation authority. No runtime launch, provider/venue calls or live activation. Control documents reference the engineering commit; implementation has not been deployed or merged by this reconciliation.
